answer: Agents bond stake and commit to a polynomial identity, evaluating its epoch-specific rate limit for each message. Semaphore/RLN proofs hide the private identity secret while binding messages to a nullifier; exceeding the allowed rate produces distinct Shamir shares, whose interpolation reveals that secret. A verifier can then slash the bonded collateral immediately, making Sybil identities costly across summit, wander, and harbor epochs.
